Rules.Error.NoEffect: Set Placement or Window corners to something other than Use global setting.

Rules_Lead.Text: Set exceptions for an app: exclude it, move it without resizing, or change its corners. Rules are checked from top to bottom. Placement and corners each use the first rule that specifies them.
Rules_EmptyHint.Text: No rules yet. Use Add rule to create one.
Rules_LimitHint.Text: Up to 200 rules. Delete a rule before adding another.
Rules_ExclusionHint.Text: Rules cannot include these windows, even with Always include.
Rules_HiddenExclusion.Text: • Windows hidden by the system, including minimized windows and windows on other virtual desktops
Rules_ShellExclusion.Text: • Shell windows such as the desktop, taskbar, Start menu, and hidden notification area icons
